paras: The diagonals produce the perspective center in the ellipse and the four tangent points. The largest diameter of the ellipse would be formed by inserting tangential rays of vision on the circle in the ground plane. The four additional tangent points through both ellipse axes simplify the construction of the curve. In the over-the-corner representation the frontal circle can be drawn at every optional vertical, because the proportions of the angles remain the same.
